name: 2151-longctx16k-codellama34b-8gpu
hardware: 8x H100 80GB HBM3, all eight GPUs of one a3 node.
parallelism: TP=8, PP=1, DP=1. One vLLM engine on one node.
architecture: dense decoder (LlamaForCausalLM, 34B, 48 layers, 64 query heads over 8 KV heads, head_dim 128, hidden 8192, 16384-token window), unquantized bf16, ~63 GiB of weights. Full config on the checkpoint.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=48, warmup 10%, cooldown 10%, bounded at 144 requests with a 3600 s safety cap, seed static 2136.
workload: synthetic `synthetic_text`, single turn, fixed by construction: every request is exactly 14080 prompt tokens and exactly 2048 output tokens (min == max on both), so a request holds 16128 of the 16384-token window at the end of its life. Prompts are independently sampled, so there is no prefix sharing. `backend.request_format: plain` — prompts go to the engine as raw text with no chat template applied.
purpose: A 34B code assistant reviewing whole repository files for 48 concurrent developers, each request 14k tokens in, 2k out, on eight GPUs.
launch:
model: codellama/CodeLlama-34b-Instruct-hf
tensor-parallel-size: 8
pipeline-parallel-size: 1
max-model-len: 16384
max-num-batched-tokens: 16384
max-num-seqs: 64
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.55
dtype: bfloat16
enforce-eager: true
swap-space: 4
block-size: 16
